title: Reference every convention node in at least one relationship edge

facts.note: Convention files and the relationship graph file are identifiable by path.
A convention node is any *.convention.yaml carrying a rule_id; detectable by parsing the file.
Graph-coverage detector: set of non-excluded node rule_ids minus all edge source_ref/target_ref values. Applies to the whole graph whenever coverage is evaluated, including pre-existing orphans.
Example triggers only (not prerequisites): diff-level observer for changes that commonly create orphans.
Planning tasks that author, rename or validate convention nodes and the graph.

fires: Graph validation finds a pre-existing non-excluded convention node referenced by no edge, even though the current plan adds, renames or removes no node or edge.
A plan adds a new *.convention.yaml with a rule_id but authors no relationship edge naming it.
A plan renames a convention's rule_id and the edges still name only the old id.
A plan deletes the last relationship edge that referenced a given convention node.
doesNotFire: A convention node lives under a path containing tests/fixtures.
A convention node is in the demo.* namespace.
A *.convention.yaml file that carries no rule_id.
Every non-excluded node already appears as source_ref or target_ref of at least one edge.

given: The repository has convention nodes (*.convention.yaml with a rule_id) and a relationship graph; this holds for all nodes, pre-existing or newly planned.
when: Relationship-graph coverage is evaluated or you plan any change touching convention nodes or graph edges.
then: Ensure every non-excluded convention node's rule_id appears as source_ref or target_ref of at least one relationship-graph edge; a node referenced by no edge is an orphan and is refused.
prefer: For each orphan (new or pre-existing), author at least one edge (via `atdd author relationship`) with it as source_ref or target_ref, using a real relationship type/foundation to a semantically related node.
Plan the edge in the same change that introduces or renames a node.
avoid: Treating 'no dangling edges' as enough — the graph must cover every node.
Placeholder edges to unrelated nodes or with arbitrary type/foundation to silence the check.
Moving a real node under tests/fixtures or into demo.* to escape the check.
unless: The node is under a path containing tests/fixtures or in the demo.* namespace — excluded.
why: Reverse half of graph integrity: the forward check forbids edges to missing nodes, this forbids nodes no edge reaches — no dangling edges AND no orphan nodes.
evidence: Graph-coverage check reports zero orphan nodes: every non-excluded convention rule_id appears as source_ref or target_ref of at least one edge in src/atdd/coach/graph/relationships.yaml.
Each newly authored edge names a real relationship type/foundation and a semantically related counterpart node.
The forward check (no edge references a missing node) also passes.
verifier_detail: Node set: every *.convention.yaml carrying a rule_id, excluding files whose path contains tests/fixtures and rule_ids in the demo.* namespace. Evaluated over the whole graph, not just changed nodes.
orphan_node: a convention node whose rule_id is referenced by no source_ref or target_ref in any relationship-graph edge.
relationship_graph: the directed convention-node graph at src/atdd/coach/graph/relationships.yaml whose edges connect node rule_ids.
Orphans = node rule_ids − (all edge source_refs ∪ all edge target_refs); any non-empty result fails.
Severity 3; disposition strict (fails on every finding).
audit: source: legacy_path src/atdd/planner/conventions/relationship.convention.yaml, legacy_section rules, extraction_mode high_fidelity, legacy_rule_id planner.relationship.no-orphan-nodes.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Placeholder edges to unrelated nodes, or relocating real nodes into excluded paths/namespaces, to evade the check.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-patterns implied by the source's requirement of a 'real relationship type/foundation to a semantically related node' and the narrow exception list.

additions.text: Plan the edge in the same change that introduces or renames a node.
additions.justification: Planner-facing timing guidance derived from the obligation; not a new obligation.
Derived from operational_guidance pairing the two checks; identifies how bidirectional integrity is established.

trace.note: Standing invariant over all non-excluded nodes; graph path kept in verifier_detail/evidence; fixture exclusion in unless.
